ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.15 focuses on real multicore fan-out before increasing worker count. The bounded scheduler replaces its single AutoResetEvent burst wake with semaphore work credits so ParallelFor batches can wake multiple existing workers immediately instead of one worker draining short bursts alone. A new parallel permissive-connectivity stage builds generation-bound map topology in independent worker stripes. It may reject statically disconnected custom GenClosest candidates before expensive live reachability checks, while every surviving candidate still uses Vanilla Reachability.CanReach and the original validator on the main thread. Destroy-through traversal modes and unsupported search shapes fail closed. The V0.4.14 persistent map search fabric, V0.4.6/V0.4.7 hauling accelerators, bounded path shadow validation, slow JobPackage tracing and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained. The worker pool remains capped at 8 until runtime peakActive/pending data proves that the pool is genuinely saturated. Performance priority: visible stutter first, stability second, TPS third.
